

---
title: "Multivariable Calculus"
---

I have been a teaching assistant for 
this course at UConn in Spring 2023, Fall 2024, Summer 2026, and Fall 2026.
When given the chance to teach the Honors discussion section,
I put together four walk-throughs on advanced topics adjacent to
standard material. For the first presentation, I used Beamer; while 
aesthetically sound, it's not as useful for interactivity as HTML, which is what I 
switched to for the next ones. The fourth and final talk will be about 
the multivariate Taylor expansion and how curvature appears in the second-order term.
